fields.name: full name
fields.title: job title (from source; may be stale)
fields.company: listed company (often NOT the real investing vehicle; see current_firm in enrichment)
fields.industries: comma-separated sector tags (investor appears under several)
fields.stages: stage tags from source (UNRELIABLE for fit; prefer enrichment focus_stages)
fields.linkedin: LinkedIn URL (join key; present on all rows)
fields.portfolio_sample: up to 3 sample portfolio companies (from source)
fields.more_portfolio: count of additional portfolio companies beyond the sample
fields.check_size: check size from source (UNRELIABLE; prefer enrichment typical_check_size)

enrichment_dataset.grain: one row per enriched investor; join to directory via wid->linkedin

fields.wid: stable enrichment id; maps to a directory row
fields.name: full name
fields.identity_confidence: high|medium|low — how sure the match is
fields.current_firm: real current investing vehicle (may differ from directory company)
fields.firm_type: angel|operator-angel|angel syndicate|seed VC|VC fund|growth equity|PE/buyout|CVC|family office|accelerator|wealth manager|other
fields.active_last_12mo: yes|no|unknown (yes only with a dated deal in last 12mo; unknown != inactive)
fields.personalization_hooks: 3-5 short factual hooks for email personalization
fields.best_email_angle: what would most likely get a reply

derived_fields_to_compute.seed_fit: bool — is this a genuine pre-seed/seed check-writer (from firm_type + role_at_firm)
derived_fields_to_compute.is_decision_maker: bool — role_at_firm is an investing partner, not ops/finance/IR
